svg.title: Concurrent FastAPI request outcomes
svg.desc: Eight synthetic requests arrive together. Three are forwarded to the mocked Hugging Face service and finish after the configured 90-millisecond delay plus application overhead. Five stop locally with HTTP 503 after the 35-millisecond admission deadline because all three concurrency slots remain occupied.
